title: Practice Paper (Block 2)
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 2 Practice Paper 2026/2027 and Mark scheme

scenes.t: This is the ICT practice paper. In the real paper you have fifty minutes and twenty five marks.
Read each question carefully. Then choose the answer you think is right.

activities.title: Q2: Matching
activities.prompt: Match each ICT word with its meaning.
pairs: A student adds a location to a holiday photograph
A company follows the location of its delivery trucks
A child uses a cartoon character to represent themselves online

items.q: Nour gets a helpful reply to her question in the class forum. What should she do?
Which action leaves a digital footprint?
A delivery company wants to follow its vehicles. Which technology should it use?
Salma adds the location of a museum to a photo. What is this called?
A sensor records the light level at 8 a.m. as 20, at 10 a.m. as 45, and at 12 p.m. as 80. Which sensor collected these readings?
At what time was the light level highest?
Did the light level increase or decrease from 8 a.m. to 12 p.m.?
Which device automatically saves the readings collected by the sensor?
Stars have 7 bottles, Planets have 3, and Comets have 9. Which cell has the highest value, if the numbers are in column B, rows 2 to 4?
Which formula uses SUM to find the total number of bottles in B5?
What is the total number of bottles?
Which Excel function finds the lowest value?
Why is a column chart useful for comparing the teams?
o: It makes it easy to compare the numbers

items.q: A digital footprint includes information left by our online activities. True or false?
It is safe to share your password in a public online discussion. True or false?
A temperature sensor records 20, 22, 35 and 24 degrees. Which reading is unusual?
What should the student do to check the unusual reading?
o: Take another reading using the sensor

items.q: Someone writes: Send me your password and I will help you with your homework. Why should Sara not share her password?
o: It could let another person get into her account

items.q: What is the safest action for Sara?
o: Share the message with all her classmates
Do not share her password, and report the message to a trusted adult

items.q: A message says: you won a free prize, click this link and enter your full name and home address. Why should Omar not trust it?
o: It asks for personal information, and the link may be unsafe

items.q: What should Omar do instead of clicking the link?
o: Do not click the link, and tell a trusted adult

items.q: Which is personal information Omar should keep private?
